s1.desc: a snowy field below rolling snowy hills, with a snow-covered pine tree

s3.desc: the inside of an igloo living room

s4.desc: the snowy yard in front of an ice-block igloo

spans.notes: extreme close-up of Polly's fins pulling on yellow cleaning gloves: only the fins are visible, no face; keep12 0.27 (fins fill the picture and move).
17 frames: Polly in yellow gloves snaps on a fluffy headband. The headband carries a small Pax face (see 66-111).

Polly carries a tower of black trash bags while the room slides behind her (compare 40/65: the doorway arch, sofa and cabinet move, Polly stays centred): a tracking pan. Also has the Pax-face headband (lead_copy).

camera locked (compare 66/110: igloo and tree black), Polly flattening cardboard boxes and stacking them. Dropped because Polly's headband carries a small drawn Pax head (blue penguin face with tuft, checked at full resolution on f30): a copy of a lead on screen the whole span. Judgement call - reverse if the lead treats the ornament as a plain outfit.
insert: a vacuum cleaner nozzle sweeping the snow, no penguin visible.
fast pull-back from the igloo wall to the wide yard (profile flagged f136/137/138 as cuts; it is one fast move).

camera locked after the pull-back (compare 142/166: tree and ground black; the igloo itself wobbles). Polly, tiny, vacuums the snow wearing the Pax-face headband: dropped for consistency with 66-111 (the ornament is only a few pixels here). 25 frames.
Pax's sled-car glides in while the view pulls back and drifts; motion settles at f187 (compare 187/188: 119 changed edge px; 188/215 car and tree black). Kept span starts one frame later for margin.

spans.view: with a small red sled-car parked on the snow and soft clouds above

beats.text: Pax sits in the parked red sled-car and turns around to reach for a briefcase on the back seat
Pax hops out of the car with the black briefcase and lands on the snow beside it
Pax stands next to the car swinging the briefcase down to his side, smiling

spans.notes: camera locked f187-215 (compare 188/215: car, tree and ground black; clouds drift in-world). Tree is drawn out of focus (static, not an effect).
camera locked (compare 216/251). Polly, wrapped in a striped blanket hood, hugs a plush toy of Pax while Pax walks in from the right with his briefcase and tie. The plush is a clear copy of Pax.
20 frames: Polly in the blanket hood, baby-faced, reaching up for a hug while holding the Pax plush (also lead_copy).
